build_checks.pass_criteria: Selected defconfig and current donor DTS build without new errors before Meizu-specific imports are applied.
ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd compiles, is registered in mt65xx_lcm_list, and is the selected CONFIG_CUSTOM_KERNEL_LCM. No donor ili9881c or hx8394 panel is selected.
DTS compiles with valid phandles, pinctrl states, GPIOs, regulators and no duplicated I2C addresses.
ft5x0x driver compiles and board binding uses I2C0 address 0x5d with valid IRQ and reset GPIOs.
BMA253, LTR578 and ST480 are all compiled or built into the expected MTK sensor framework with correct I2C bindings and orientation data.
IMX278 and OV8856JSL source files compile, are included in the mt6755 imgsensor Makefile, are registered in kd_sensorlist, and expose driver names matching stock camera HAL expectations.
AW3643 compiles in the active MTK flashlight framework and binds to I2C1 address 0x63 with safe current limits.
Active charger path is bq24157 for I2C1 address 0x6a; sy6923d is not accidentally selected for this board; thermal and JEITA tables are reviewed.
MT6605 compiles, binds to I2C4 address 0x28, and has valid VEN/IRQ GPIO wiring.
Sunwave driver compiles, board bus/GPIOs are proven from stock evidence, and device-node naming matches the vendor HAL.
Wi-Fi and audio are either confirmed present with exact drivers and DTS/config wiring or produce explicit follow-up import tasks.

After boot: display init, touch input, charger detection, battery telemetry, sensors, camera probe, flash probe, NFC probe, fingerprint probe, Wi-Fi and audio are checked separately in kernel log and userspace service logs.

confidence.reason: Local kernel scan gives useful evidence, but several matches are weak and the selected tree appears to be a Huawei MT6750/MT6755 donor tree rather than a Meizu M6-specific tree.

repo_search_queries.acceptance_rule: Prefer MTK 3.18 mt6750/mt6755 vendor source with the exact LCM_DRIVER name and matching DSI timing/reset/bias sequence.
Prefer MTK legacy ALSPS framework driver compatible with kernel 3.18 and hwmsen/alsps registration used by the selected tree.
Require a real sensor C driver plus kd_sensorlist registration; kd_imgsensor.h alone is not enough.
Prefer source naming that preserves the jsl module variant if stock HAL expects ov8856jslmipiraw.
Use the MTK flashlight framework version matching the selected tree; do not substitute a generic LED class driver unless the camera HAL path supports it.
Require charger implementation compatible with the MTK charging control API used in this tree and validate all charge-current limits.
Only needed if the imported ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd driver lacks a compatible TPS65132 bias helper.

risks.detail: Using ili9881c or another donor LCM instead of ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd can cause black screen or unsafe panel power sequencing.
risks.mitigation: Import exact stock LCM and verify with stock LK/DTS/log evidence.

risks.detail: The donor tree appears to contain sy6923d charging code while stock hardware says bq24157.
risks.mitigation: Do not enable charging until bq24157 implementation and limits are verified.

risks.detail: IMX278 was counted as found from kd_imgsensor.h only, which is not a working sensor driver.
risks.mitigation: Require real sensor source and kd_sensorlist registration.

risks.detail: The profile mixes mt6750 and mt6755 context, while the tree is Huawei 6750_66_N.
risks.mitigation: Treat SoC identity as family context and verify pinctrl, clocks, power and DTS against Meizu stock evidence.

risks.detail: BMA253 and ST480 sources exist but may use donor mount matrices.
risks.mitigation: Use stock orientation and calibration parameters.

risks.detail: TPS65132 references exist in non-stock LCMs only; wrong voltage or timing may damage or fail the panel.
risks.mitigation: Tie TPS65132 handling to exact stock LCM sequence.

risks.detail: Sunwave source exists, but bus, GPIOs and ioctl naming are not proven.
risks.mitigation: Validate against stock DTS and vendor HAL device-node expectations.

risks.detail: Current profile does not cover Wi-Fi or audio, so a booting kernel may still lack major functionality.
risks.mitigation: Run separate Wi-Fi and audio inventory before final adaptation signoff.
